subject: general
question: DG 25 is related to FH 21 in a certain way. In the same way, GI 19 is related to IJ 15. To which of the following is MI 24 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, DG 25 is related to FH 21

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a462d8b7f2b9474fda6d6d7dc716b15315a588e69e67142b4460840956135644.png] 

For, GI 19 is related to IJ 15

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/746010cce3d42b2089e53dac87e266ef161d6f99dc69e011aee01640d1c69d1e.png] 

Similarly, for MI 24

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e47a5ff131a89ac8fdb332d0772596c2c561c46dcf03db150b4ff1b1af2ca0cf.png] 

So, '**MI 24**' will be related to **'OJ 20**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
